name: Chic Le Frique
tagline_real: Crafted for the bold, designed to be timeless.
logo_hint: Lowercase 'chiclefrique' wordmark, clean modern sans-serif, high-contrast black-on-white minimalism
brand_notes: Dubai women's fashion e-tailer (founded 2019), own line + curated international labels (Runaway, Bardot, ASTR, Lioness). Real site is a clean Montserrat-style sans on white with warm accents (buttercup, fire red, burnt copper, blush). For an editorial, premium pitch feel I pair a Fraunces serif display (bold + timeless, matches the tagline) with Inter body, on a warm ivory (#F7F2EC) ground with a burnt-copper (#B25B3E) accent and buttercup (#E8B84B) / blush (#E3B3A6) secondaries. Resort-luxe, feminine, confident. Espresso-near-black text on ivory passes WCAG AA.
